_about: The fast-versus-panel agreement report (GAD-T662): how often the live turn's fast model disagreed with the full grading panel.
provisional.title: Fast-model agreement
provisional.notPermitted: That exam was not found, or this report is shown only to people who view analytics.
provisional.intro: During an exam a fast model judges each answer at once so the examiner can respond without waiting; the full grading panel judges the same answer afterwards. This report compares the two: how often the panel marked a material disagreement with the fast model, and how far apart their scores were. It reads the stored transcripts; nothing is sent to a model.
provisional.mock: These judgments come from the mock fast model, so the figures show the workflow, not a real model's agreement.
provisional.auditMismatch: The audit log records {0} disagreements but the transcripts record {1}. Some sessions may be missing from one or the other.
provisional.none: No turn judged by the fast model has a panel judgment to compare with yet.
provisional.subject: Subject
provisional.footnote: The rate's range is a 95% Wilson interval. Groups with fewer than {0} compared turns are marked as too few to read. The gap is the fast model's score minus the panel's: positive means the fast model scored higher.
